I wonder why some many states seem to be facing severe to exceptional drought. I also wonder how this will affect agriculture and food production in general. Additionally, I wonder is there any steps that can occurring. to prevent or fix the issue of how many droughts are occurring.
This relates to me and my community because it shows on the map that NY isn't facing any drought so that explains why this news hasn’t been discussed much.
